# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM
**Amendment No. 8 to Credit and Guarantee Agreement - Contango Ore, Inc.**

---

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** July 30, 2024

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Core Alaska, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, serves as the borrower under this credit facility. The company is guaranteed by Contango Ore, Inc. (Delaware corporation), Contango Lucky Shot Alaska, LLC (Alaska LLC), Contango Minerals Alaska, LLC (Alaska LLC), and Contango Mining Canada, Inc. (British Columbia corporation).

**Transaction Description:** This represents the eighth amendment to the original Credit and Guarantee Agreement dated May 17, 2023. The transaction is structured as a credit facility with ING Capital LLC serving as Administrative Agent, with Macquarie Bank Limited as co-Mandated Lead Arranger alongside ING Capital LLC (which also serves as Bookrunner).

**Purpose of Financing:** N/A - The amendment specifically modifies the "Required Commercial Operation Date" definition but does not specify the original purpose of the underlying credit facility.

**Company Background:** Based on the entity names and Required Commercial Operation Date covenant, this appears to be a mining operation with assets in Alaska and Canada. The borrower and guarantor entities suggest involvement in mineral extraction activities, though specific operational details are not provided in this amendment.

---

## INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Multiple guarantor structure** - Credit is supported by four separate guarantor entities across different jurisdictions
• **Established banking relationship** - Facility arranged by reputable institutions (ING Capital LLC and Macquarie Bank Limited)
• **Covenant compliance** - Borrower represents that no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing
• **Security package** - References to Collateral Documents indicate secured lending structure
• **Operational milestone flexibility** - Amendment extends Required Commercial Operation Date, suggesting lender accommodation

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Timeline extension risk** - Required Commercial Operation Date moved to October 31, 2024, indicating potential operational delays
• **Mining sector exposure** - Inherent commodity price volatility and operational risks in mining industry
• **Multiple amendments** - This is the eighth amendment since May 2023, suggesting ongoing covenant or operational challenges
• **Complex guarantor structure** - Multi-jurisdictional guarantor base (Delaware, Alaska, British Columbia) may complicate enforcement
• **Limited financial visibility** - Amendment does not provide current financial metrics or covenant compliance details
